study.question: Observed limitation: g0-r0030-primary_context_allowed click AUC=0.6669000087261666 versus primary_context_blocked=0.6668051956575413 (difference 0.0000948130686253). The auxiliary training-population effect is 0.0000554656172104 when context gradients are allowed, and exactly zero in click AUC when blocked. Source inspection shows the previous gate blocked context simultaneously at direct auxiliary towers and task-conditioned history adapters. Which path contributes the small aggregate benefit, and can adapter-only context supervision retain it while removing a competing direct-tower update? This is an attribution study of an observed but single-seed effect, not established transfer or novelty.
study.hypothesis: Auxiliary supervision through the task-specific history adapter may shape shared context toward useful compressed-history corrections, whereas the direct auxiliary tower update can compete with click ranking. With primary auxiliary normalization fixed, enabling only adapter-context gradients is predicted to improve click AUC over neither-enabled and at least preserve all-enabled quality. The adapter simple effect should exceed the direct-tower simple effect. This is provisional: the observed aggregate effect is small and could reflect seed/optimizer coupling. Historical failures constrain the rationale: compressed_task g0-r0006=0.6591942389399411 underperformed event_task=0.660163362657485; task match_detail g0-r0009=0.6630190236433535 exceeded shared=0.6616459256823809; cubic_ordered g0-r0019=0.665704885611003 underperformed duplicate=0.6659300360390669; partial mean-only/variance-only moment gradients g0-r0023=0.6650149110872101/0.6654753133736193 both underperformed both=0.666753547526167. Neither compression alone, additional moments, nor partial gradient removal is assumed beneficial.

nearest_work.difference: Exact local architectural ancestor. Replace the single combined context gate by independent backward-only gates at auxiliary adapter and direct tower context inputs; complete 2x2 with both corners bridged. No learned capacity or forward feature change.

Inherits local-activation scoring and Dice from the existing field/four-task adaptation. DIN primary text specifies training batch moments and inference moving averages; the benchmark uses native BatchNorm eps1e-9/momentum0.01. This study retains those operators and populations and examines two auxiliary context backward paths; no exact DIN reproduction or priority claim.

inherited_components: All learned tensors, construction order/reset and RNG operations from history_g0_r0030_primary_context_allowed.py: FeatureEmbeddingDict, action-aware shared scorer, four towers and zero-initialized four task adapters.
Uniform/feedback compression; attached rotated-duplicate normalization support; folded training scorer and fully-pruned eval scorer; all target-match and ordinal/curvature summaries.

study.proposed_difference: Add two Boolean architecture controls block_aux_tower_context_grad and block_aux_adapter_context_grad. Keep the old combined block_aux_context_grad=False and all other architecture settings fixed. In each auxiliary task during training, independently detach task_context only where concatenated into the adapter input and/or direct tower input. Click and all eval computations use original context. Execute every learned module in each cell; no new parameters, loss hook, features, persistent buffers or RNG. Adapter-only is candidate; tower-only and both corners are controls. Every listed file is standalone.
predictions: At a fixed shared parameter/buffer state, all four cells have identical probabilities, inputs to learned operators and BatchNorm updates; eval logits must agree. Only backward edges into auxiliary context differ.

Both-enabled reproduces g0-r0030-primary_context_allowed and neither-enabled reproduces g0-r0030-primary_context_blocked under the same frozen seed/recipe, within a measured deterministic/BF16 numerical tolerance defined before viewing new validation metrics.

Adapter-only has click AUC above neither-enabled and no lower than all-enabled. Adapter-context simple effects are predicted larger than tower-context effects. An improvement >=0.0001 over all-enabled is the prespecified practical threshold for a new paired-seed confirmation branch; smaller differences remain exploratory.

All cells retain 32129765 total/336549 dense parameters and inherited buffers. Detach-only overhead should keep full wall cost within 10% of the approximately354-second bridge; this is a prediction, not measured equal compute.

The first zero-output-adapter step has zero adapter-context gradient; after a nonzero output-weight update the adapter-only route should show nonzero auxiliary context gradients while tower-only blocks that route. Both-blocked auxiliary context and all auxiliary scorer/item/action gradients are zero on a single-task loss graph.
falsifiers: Adapter-only failing to exceed neither-enabled, or tower-only matching/exceeding adapter-only, contradicts the proposed preferential adapter-context explanation for this implementation.

Failure to preserve all-enabled click AUC rejects adapter-only as a useful candidate; retaining the incumbent is an admissible outcome. Failure to exceed both frozen source bests rejects useful source complementarity for the tested candidate.

A fixed-state probability/buffer mismatch, changed learned capacity/initialization, or forbidden auxiliary scorer/item gradient invalidates a backward-only causal interpretation. Corner bridge mismatch must be diagnosed before mechanism comparisons.

The apparent benefit vanishing/reversing across later paired seeds, or being accounted for by uncontrolled clipping/optimizer changes, precludes repeated mechanistic support. A single seed is never significance evidence.
Measured wall cost above the predicted10% overhead or trial/resource caps makes the efficiency prediction false; do not repair by changing frozen training or evaluation.
alternative_explanations: One prescribed seed cannot establish repeatability or statistical significance; repeated bridge runs at the same seed are implementation controls, not independent replications.
Dense global gradient clipping can mediate indirect task coupling through changed gradients. No claim of complete isolation.
Gradient gates change optimization of shared context, including sparse Adagrad accumulators; this study identifies path interventions, not an optimizer-independent mechanism.
Zero-initialized adapter output means adapter-mediated context gradients begin only after adapter output weights learn.
Source equivalence and matched capacity do not establish numeric/BF16 parity or equal measured runtime; host validation is mandatory.
The entire aggregate context gain may come from direct auxiliary classification rather than task-conditioned history correction.
Both routes may be complementary or redundant; an interaction can make one partial gate harmful even when its simple effect is positive in the other context.
AUC differences can be selection noise after many prior branches; many same-seed trajectory observations are not independent confirmation.
Task-specific auxiliary AUC tradeoffs do not establish impression-specific conversion modeling because auxiliary labels have category/brand24h semantics.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Reviewed authorized card and pinned benchmark forward/block source; original paper provenance only, not available full text. This local observation warrants separating backward paths before adding another architecture. No new component adopted; prior usage declarations do not establish causality.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: None imported. Independent context edge stop-gradients come from the local round30 combined-gate limitation.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Retain existing compressed-history/Dice/task adapters; add no task hubs, token exchange, FFNs or capacity. INFNet original-method equivalence and novelty remain unverified.
